notes.title: The old version of the game is back!
notes.notes: The old version of the game is available again, you can access it by clicking on the crocodile in the lower left corner in the main menu. Thank you to everyone who supports us!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Fixed a bug in yesterday's update.
notes.notes:
If you encounter an error that the Steam client could not find the executable file. Please update the game and the error will be fixed. If the update does not help, please uninstall and reinstall the game. 
Thank you for playing your games.

notes.title: OS support update and Find All 2 release
notes.notes:
The game is now available on macOS and Linux + SteamOS platforms.
This update is timed to coincide with the release of the next game Find All 2 Middle Ages.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1722520/FIND_ALL_2_Middle_Ages
